name: DKG RAG Pipeline
description: RAG pipeline using DKG V10 Working/Shared Memory as vector-searchable retrieval source with provenance citations. Ingests documents as Knowledge Assets, indexes with local embeddings, and serves ranked chunks to any LLM for grounded generation.

install.usageHint: dkg-rag ingest <file> && dkg-rag query <text> && dkg-rag share <ka> && dkg-rag serve

security.notes: Egress: local DKG node only by default; optional operator-configured embedding/LLM endpoints require https plus explicit opt-in (DKG_ALLOW_REMOTE_ENDPOINT=1). Secret redaction gate scans all text and quads before any write or provider call. Auth token from ~/.dkg/auth.token or env; request bodies capped at 1 MiB (invalid cap values fall back to the documented default). Zero runtime dependencies.

promotionPath: Ingested documents land in Working Memory as provenance-tagged Knowledge Assets. 'dkg-rag share <ka>' promotes a document to Shared Working Memory (swm/share seals by default, publish-ready). No automatic promotion and no daemon; VM publishing is not implemented in Round 1.
fitNotes: WM/SWM as RAG retrieval source directly serves the LLM-Wiki/Autoresearch theme. Distinct from OpenClaw memory curator (agent-specific daemon), DKG Memory MCP server (transport layer), and Hermes bridge (agent audit trail). This is an infra/retrieval layer usable by any agent or application.
